proposal.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding candidate keppel-19. The targeted H1 contrast yields 139 significant genes (87 up, 52 down) while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260 (194 up, 66 down) — the control has 121 more qualifying genes than the targeted clone. 48 genes are shared (48/139 = 0.3453 of targeted; 48/260 = 0.1846 of control; Jaccard 48/351 = 0.1368), all 48 in the same direction, leaving 91 targeted-only and 212 control-only genes. Because a substantial fraction of the targeted signature is reproduced by untargeted H1 variation, the DE tables alone cannot attribute the changes to the candidate region, and no frozen DE-count, overlap or distance threshold in the supplied criteria establishes exclusion, causality or safety. The GENCODE v36 annotation criteria (gene-body overlap, TSS >50 kb, miRNA >300 kb, lncRNA >100 kb) were not computed by the available proximity tool, which returned only DE-gene proximity; cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region sources are unavailable. Aggregate evidence therefore remains incomplete, and missing evidence is not a negative biological result.

Do the 9 unmapped DE identifiers (noncanonical/alt/patch contigs, e.g. CHR_HSCHR6_MHC_QBL_CTG1, CHR_HG926_PATCH) hide additional chr19 proximity relationships?
Are the COSMIC v92 cancer-gene, ENCFF503GCK DHS and versioned ultraconserved-region criteria satisfiable? All three are unavailable.
Do the qPCR means for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210) reach significance, and what is their relationship to the candidate interval? Only replicate means were supplied.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared, so 91 of 139 targeted DE genes (65.5%) are targeted-only and the overlap fraction is 0.345. Because 48/139 targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control comparison, part of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, but the remaining targeted-only changes are not explained by this control and control overlap cannot establish causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a 53,277 bp interval gap / 53,278 bp nearest-reference-base distance and the nearest TSS at 53,278 bp, so the frozen >50 kb TSS criterion passes; miRNA (468,021 bp) and lncRNA (106,065 bp) distance criteria also pass. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be declared. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not (noncanonical/patch contigs), and the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774,116 bp away. The qPCR endpoint means for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210) are near zero, but no frozen exclusion threshold exists for any endpoint. No named experimental endpoint result supports exclusion, so evidence_status is unknown and exclusion_decision is not_justified_by_available_evidence.

The targeted RNA-seq contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, so the targeted/control overlap fraction is 0.3453. This overlap shows that a substantial share of targeted DE genes also changes in untargeted H1 cultures, but overlap and proximity cannot establish causality or safety, and no frozen DE-count, overlap or distance threshold defines exclusion. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and the nearest TSS reference-base distance of 53278 bp; nearest miRNA (MIR4747) 468021 bp and nearest lncRNA (AC005790.1) 106065 bp. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774116 bp away by interval gap. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. The qPCR endpoint reports near-zero mean log2 fold changes for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210), but these are descriptive replicate means without a frozen exclusion threshold and do not establish safety. Overall suitability is not established.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared, so 91 of 139 targeted DE genes (65.5%) are targeted-only and the overlap fraction is 0.345. Because 48/139 targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control comparison, part of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, but the remaining targeted-only changes are not explained by this control and control overlap cannot establish causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a 53,277 bp interval gap / 53,278 bp nearest-reference-base distance and the nearest TSS at 53,278 bp, so the frozen >50 kb TSS criterion passes; miRNA (468,021 bp) and lncRNA (106,065 bp) distance criteria also pass. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be declared. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools.

optimizer.rationale: Development traces show H0 failed on controls_withheld because the inspect role failed after revision, while R0 completed; H0 also had unsupported_count 3 on full_sources. The failure appears tied to inspect attempting to resolve control availability and missing evidence. Splitting inspect into a pure evidence-inventory role and an upstream evidence-review role that explicitly handles missing controls should reduce failure risk and improve completeness. Validation could disprove this if the new topology does not improve completion on controls_withheld or increases unsupported_count.

rule.additional_benefit: more correct required decisions OR >=15% provider-reported cost reduction at equal quality

rule.benefit_scope: required decision count, or complete actual provider-reported inference cost at equal quality; optimizer overhead reported separately

promotion.cost_interpretation: One paired comparison is provisional; optimizer and full evaluation overhead are excluded from inference-cost reduction and reported separately.

evaluation_overhead.scope: Deterministic scoring duration only; no evaluator model call. Ingestion and development engineering excluded.

report.case_coverage_note: Every assigned arm/case, including failed or blocked executions, must appear in case_results. Unexecuted future splits remain explicitly pending in the experiment assignment.
limitations: Nine scenarios share three publication-derived loci; variants stay in the same split. There is one independent locus per development, validation, and final split.
Reference answers have not been human-reviewed.
A single paired stochastic cost result is provisional.
Unknown usage remains unknown; known partial sums are not complete cost totals.
Durations in arm totals sum run durations and are not the experiment's elapsed wall time.
Optimizer and evaluator overhead must be considered separately and in total; promotion inference-cost percentage excludes this overhead.
A rejected proposal demonstrates selection behavior, not successful self-improvement.
No biological safety, causal attribution, novel-site discovery, whole-genome search, or billion-token performance is established.

Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.

evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Read the named criteria and their parameters. Report all required missing criteria, including unavailable cancer-gene/regulatory evidence. Never infer an overall pass from the available subset.

raw_model_proposal.conclusion: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared, so 91 of 139 targeted DE genes (65.5%) are targeted-only and the overlap fraction is 0.345. Because 48/139 targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control comparison, part of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, but the remaining targeted-only changes are not explained by this control and control overlap cannot establish causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a 53,277 bp interval gap / 53,278 bp nearest-reference-base distance and the nearest TSS at 53,278 bp, so the frozen >50 kb TSS criterion passes; miRNA (468,021 bp) and lncRNA (106,065 bp) distance criteria also pass. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be declared. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not (noncanonical/patch contigs), and the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774,116 bp away. The qPCR endpoint means for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210) are near zero, but no frozen exclusion threshold exists for any endpoint. No named experimental endpoint result supports exclusion, so evidence_status is unknown and exclusion_decision is not_justified_by_available_evidence.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared, so 91 of 139 targeted DE genes (65.5%) are targeted-only and the overlap fraction is 0.345. Because 48/139 targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control comparison, part of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, but the remaining targeted-only changes are not explained by this control and control overlap cannot establish causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a 53,277 bp interval gap / 53,278 bp nearest-reference-base distance and the nearest TSS at 53,278 bp, so the frozen >50 kb TSS criterion passes; miRNA (468,021 bp) and lncRNA (106,065 bp) distance criteria also pass. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be declared. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not (noncanonical/patch contigs), and the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774,116 bp away. The qPCR endpoint means for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210) are near zero, but no frozen exclusion threshold exists for any endpoint. No named experimental endpoint result supports exclusion, so evidence_status is unknown and exclusion_decision is not_justified_by_available_evidence.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19 (chr19:5400760-5402139, GRCh38, zero-based half-open). The targeted RNA-seq contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, so the targeted/control overlap fraction is 0.3453. This overlap shows that a substantial share of targeted DE genes also changes in untargeted H1 cultures, but overlap and proximity cannot establish causality or safety, and no frozen DE-count, overlap or distance threshold defines exclusion. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and the nearest TSS reference-base distance of 53278 bp; nearest miRNA (MIR4747) 468021 bp and nearest lncRNA (AC005790.1) 106065 bp. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774116 bp away by interval gap. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. The qPCR endpoint reports near-zero mean log2 fold changes for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210), but these are descriptive replicate means without a frozen exclusion threshold and do not establish safety. Overall suitability is not established.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19 (chr19:5400760-5402139, GRCh38, zero-based half-open). The targeted RNA-seq contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, so the targeted/control overlap fraction is 0.3453. This overlap shows that a substantial share of targeted DE genes also changes in untargeted H1 cultures, but overlap and proximity cannot establish causality or safety, and no frozen DE-count, overlap or distance threshold defines exclusion. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and the nearest TSS reference-base distance of 53278 bp; nearest miRNA (MIR4747) 468021 bp and nearest lncRNA (AC005790.1) 106065 bp. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774116 bp away by interval gap. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. The qPCR endpoint reports near-zero mean log2 fold changes for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210), but these are descriptive replicate means without a frozen exclusion threshold and do not establish safety. Overall suitability is not established.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared, so 91 of 139 targeted DE genes (65.5%) are targeted-only and the overlap fraction is 0.345. Because 48/139 targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control comparison, part of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, but the remaining targeted-only changes are not explained by this control and control overlap cannot establish causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a 53,277 bp interval gap / 53,278 bp nearest-reference-base distance and the nearest TSS at 53,278 bp, so the frozen >50 kb TSS criterion passes; miRNA (468,021 bp) and lncRNA (106,065 bp) distance criteria also pass. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be declared. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not (noncanonical/patch contigs), and the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774,116 bp away. The qPCR endpoint means for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210) are near zero, but no frozen exclusion threshold exists for any endpoint. immutable_assessment_revisions.conclusion: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared, so 91 of 139 targeted DE genes (65.5%) are targeted-only and the overlap fraction is 0.345. Because 48/139 targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control comparison, part of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, but the remaining targeted-only changes are not explained by this control and control overlap cannot establish causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a 53,277 bp interval gap / 53,278 bp nearest-reference-base distance and the nearest TSS at 53,278 bp, so the frozen >50 kb TSS criterion passes; miRNA (468,021 bp) and lncRNA (106,065 bp) distance criteria also pass. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be declared. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not (noncanonical/patch contigs), and the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774,116 bp away. The qPCR endpoint means for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210) are near zero, but no frozen exclusion threshold exists for any endpoint. No named experimental endpoint result supports exclusion, so evidence_status is unknown and exclusion_decision is not_justified_by_available_evidence.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.
